events.text: Look at the moss on this ledge. You can see every strand.
Someone hand-sculpted every brick. I can tell.
Is that a ledge? It's not yellow, so no.
The lighting in here... I need a minute.
Yellow button. I know this one.
Back to where I left off.
I'll stand here until it's yellow.
The flag! I can see the flag!
Made it! Can I go back and look at the scenery?

profile.intro: Plays on his phone during cutscenes. Follows yellow instantly, won't move an inch without it.
